design: All five tasks, item0-3 training only; item4-7/new wording evaluation. Four training regimes: same task/new wording, same task/old wording, other tasks/new wording, other tasks/old wording. Every task retains its own sentence format; new-wording label does not mean a common cross-task shell. Predict prefix dc from MLP11 normalized input, MLP5 normalized input, or Attention5 final write. Fixed ridge regularization .1 times mean Gram diagonal. Include per-regime constant mean. No evaluation dc used for predictions. Earlier-state models see final position only.
scope: Adaptive reused evaluation panel; new native captures extend training items and add predictor states. Main split is by item ID, not guaranteed lexical disjointness. Other-task models get32 contexts versus8 same-task. Test exactly same recipients and signals in every mode. No model selection on evaluation.
